text:
Good question! 🌿 No, Leafy Plus does **not** make Express shipping free.

- **Free Standard shipping** is included, with no minimum order.
- **Express shipping** stays at **$14.95**, even for Leafy Plus members.

Express delivery times depend on your zone: next business day in Zone 1, and 2 business days in Zone 2. Express isn't available in Zone 3. XL plants ship Standard only.

Thanks for checking before you sign up! If you have any other questions, just ask. Happy planting! 🌱
